summary: Most artifacts and deterministic checks are present, but the ClaimGraph divergence guard does not reject every divergent Requirement Agent ClaimGraph output, so the core TASK-0093 behavioral claim is not fully satisfied.

criteria.evidence: Patch adds acceptance-first drafting, frozen ClaimGraph digest capture, Requirement Agent readOnlyInputs, and tests for common mismatch cases. However _ensure_requirement_did_not_rewrite_claim_graph selects candidate with requirement.get("claimGraph") or requirement.get("claim_graph"), so a present falsey divergent claimGraph such as an empty mapping is ignored instead of rejected.
concerns: The acceptance requirement says any ClaimGraph divergence rejects the draft as untrusted input; this falsey-present ClaimGraph case is not rejected and is not covered by tests.

blocking_issues: src/ahra/alignment_session.py:_ensure_requirement_did_not_rewrite_claim_graph uses truthiness to detect Requirement Agent ClaimGraph output. A present but falsey claimGraph value is treated as absent, so not every ClaimGraph divergence is rejected as required.
